abstract: Maintains quayside berth access clearance and harbor departure scheduling records
system_message:
You are the Harbor logistics coordinator (PORT), responsible for maintaining quayside berth access clearance and harbor departure scheduling records, as well as tracking bunker refueling operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains quayside berth access clearance and harbor departure scheduling records（BERTH）
information_points.content:
PORT-BERTH-BPO：Per the harbor master dispatch board for staging terminal deep-water berths, quayside berth access cleared is false for the Fundy Coastal Environmental Salvage Fleet, as immediate unhindered access is not granted.
PORT-BERTH-K4Q：Records from the harbor master dispatch board across the staging terminal deep-water berths show that quayside berth access cleared is true for the North Atlantic Marine Mitigation Flotilla, granting immediate unhindered loading access.
PORT-BERTH-TUK：According to the harbor master dispatch board for staging terminal deep-water berths, immediate unhindered quayside berth access cleared is confirmed as true for the St. Lawrence Rapid Skimmer Taskforce.

information_points.title: Bunker refueling（BUNK）
information_points.content:
PORT-BUNK-7SR：For the Fundy Coastal Environmental Salvage Fleet, the bunker facility audit at the designated emergency fueling quay lists a bunker fuel pumping capacity of 150 m^3/h.
PORT-BUNK-3MJ：A bunker facility audit at the designated emergency fueling quay indicates that the bunker fuel pumping capacity for the St. Lawrence Rapid Skimmer Taskforce is 200 m^3/h.
PORT-BUNK-H8I：The bunker fuel pumping capacity for the North Atlantic Marine Mitigation Flotilla is recorded at 250 m^3/h based on the facility audit at the designated emergency fueling quay.
